semantics: a revised claim identical (normalized) to an unsupported claim under the same ID stays blocked (F6-A2-FR2 unchanged)
a revised claim whose normalized text already appears in the merged set is discarded as an exact restatement
a revised claim that reuses an existing local claim ID for genuinely new content is preserved under a fresh local ID (claim_id_r2, claim_id_r3, ...) instead of being silently dropped
the merged draft is re-verified as before; a revised claim that fails verification still ends up unsupported and the missing obligation stays missing
A_revision_recovery.boundedness: at most one revision, unchanged; no second retrieval, no E3

semantics: schema now requires an answer_point_coverage record per runtime answer point: {answer_point_id, supporting_claim_ids, complete}

deterministic validation: exactly one record per point; supporting claims must be known, not unsupported/irrelevant, and mapped to the point; complete=true requires at least one supported contributing claim; complete=false must be exactly the missing_answer_point_ids set

prompt instructs the reviewer to judge the substantive relationship each obligation requests (workflow ordering, purpose, comparison, location, condition, cause/effect) and to mark complete=false when the claims leave it unstated

generation contract: retrieved evidence is a non-exhaustive subset; never state or imply corpus-wide absence from that subset alone; state only that the supplied evidence does not establish the unsupported side; corpus-wide absence belongs exclusively to deterministic exact-lookup refusal paths

verification contract: a corpus-wide absence claim inferred from a non-exhaustive subset is not evidence-supported and must be marked unsupported; when cited evidence directly establishes the denied thing, the claim is unsupported

deferred_mechanisms.mechanism: rerank_pool = fused_order[:30] bounds the reranker input; role-critical candidates ranked below the bound are lost before reranking and cannot be recovered without per-obligation retrieval signals, a documentation quota, or global reselection
deferred_mechanisms.defer_reason: no existing generic per-obligation signal exists for a single-obligation query; a documentation/role quota lacks a generic architecture argument; the remaining robust options would effectively promote deferred E3/global-reselection machinery
